cemc-hypatia-2022-04a.prompt:
Every integer $N > 1$ can be written as $N = p_1^{a_1} p_2^{a_2} p_3^{a_3} \cdots p_k^{a_k}$, where $k$ is a positive integer, $p_1 < p_2 < p_3 < \cdots < p_k$ are prime numbers, and $a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots, a_k$ are positive integers. For example, $1400 = 2^3 5^2 7^1$.

The number of positive divisors of $N$ is denoted by $f(N)$. It is known that
$$f(N) = (1 + a_1)(1 + a_2)(1 + a_3) \cdots (1 + a_k)$$

(a) How many positive divisors does 240 have? That is, what is the value of $f(240)$?
